bio_draft: Zokhuma is the Mumbai-based electronic project of Arman Menzies, formerly the guitarist of progressive metal band Goddess Gagged. He began with melodic downtempo tracks in 2014 and moved toward leftfield club music with IDM and breaks on the 2019 EP Code. He has recorded a Mixmag Asia Radio mix and played The Lab Goa back to back with Dreamstates.
notes: Former band (not an alias): Goddess Gagged, guitar. Homegrown pages show 8 June 2021 dates but describe him as 21 and fresh from the band split, so they look like 2014 pieces re-dated in a site migration; dates left null. The Wild City 'Code' article sits at an odd URL (/businesses/9108-terra-mayaa) but the page text is the Code EP piece; check it renders before linking. Mixmag Asia's URL slug spells 'zohkuma'. Rolling Stone India ran 'Zokhuma: Former Goddess Gagged guitarist launches solo project' (29 Mar 2014) but the tag page gave no URL. Hearts + Fields. is 2 tracks (labelled album on Bandcamp), TRICE is 3 tracks, Tomorrow Will Be Better 5 tracks. Bookings via Interbeing agency per SoundCloud profile. Mixmag Lab says he studied music production in the UK.

bio_draft: Norbu is an electronic music producer, sound designer and DJ from Chandigarh, active in the underground scene since 2021. His music sits between leftfield bass, dubstep, UK garage, DnB and IDM, with releases on Deep Tempo Records, OneFortyAsia, Sec13 Records and Screech Collective.
notes: The SoundCloud URL was found by trying the Instagram handle, not via a link on a page, so confirm it before publishing (the handle and sound match). The profile also claims support from Rinse FM, NTS, Keep Hush and Subtle Radio (not verified). norbumusic.bandcamp.com is a namesake (Ben Norbu Bultrini, Mexico City): do not use. Rolling Stone India's Carolina Norbu is also a different artist. Releases on the labels named could not be found before the search budget ran out.
